macos.environment: GitHub-hosted Apple Silicon; each application process tested with empty Godot data, system and GPU caches retained. Virtual GPU may report no nonzero GPU timestamps.
macos.cold_scope: New application process and empty Godot data directory per launch; no driver cache removal or full host reboot.

treatment.prior_fix: Read the MeshInstance3D resources directly rather than construct and dispose the complete model library at startup.
treatment.rc19_result: The original suite first Metal attempt stopped after scene_ready with zero drawn frames and no first_post_draw. The same exported ZIP reproduced on an independent hosted Mac. No claim of first launch repaired.

same_package_control.main_thread: 88 of 88 samples in ShaderRD::_compile_version_end during Metal mobile material parameter update, waiting for the worker group; current call stack, not proof of a particular shader or a physical M5 issue.
